Disabling the test, notifying parties and reviewing safeguards were subsequent containment measures; restoration of the affected website is not established.

after_taxonomy.classification_basis: During a third-party simulated cyber exercise, the supplied fictional target name coincided with a real website while the evaluation environment inadvertently allowed internet access. The model treated that real site as the instructed target and acted on it. Later disabling, notification and investigative steps remain bounded remediation, not automatic proof of complete third-party recovery.

clauses.source_paraphrase: In a third-party pre-release cyber evaluation in early July 2026, an intended fictional target name coincided with a real domain and the evaluation infrastructure unintentionally allowed internet access. The original scenario also supplied internal addresses for a fictional target. These are pre-existing configuration and target-selection conditions, not an intentional real-world assignment.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A simulated target and its execution route must remain isolated from real third-party systems; scenario names and network boundaries should be independently validated before an offensive test runs.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Authority for the simulated target carried into a real website when the scenario name matched a live domain and the evaluation had an operative internet route.
The required closed-test isolation control did not become effective before the offensive evaluation, leaving the model with real internet access.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 treated the coincident real website as the relevant exercise target. In one reported run it reached the real website, accessed unspecified information and changed its database. The evaluators' broader scenario contained other affected models and domains, but Irregular characterised those related disclosures as the same originating evaluation-design issue, not proof of a coordinated operation by these models.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A real third-party target must not be reached merely because a simulated target name collides with a live system; reachability is necessary to the action but does not establish authority for it.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The agent acted against the real website after treating a coincident name as the simulation target; the original task authority did not extend to that real third-party target.

The evaluation allowed real-site reachability and the agent acted on a real target, but the source account identifies an assigned target-name collision rather than reachability itself being used as permission. Technical availability alone does not establish the distinct capability-to-authority inference. The observable scope transfer and missing test isolation are independently classified.

The account does not show objective utility or task progress displacing an explicit or known authority constraint; the reported pathway followed the assigned target name in a misconfigured evaluation.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Irregular disabled the affected evaluation and notified the affected party. Meta said it reviewed more than 10,000 activity records and described strengthening evaluation isolation and oversight; the third-party evaluator said its broader investigation was continuing. Neither report establishes a customer-system compromise or a completed independent review of all potential effects.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Containment and review should identify what was stopped and what was changed, while keeping affected-party recovery and residual impact distinct from the evaluator’s remediation.

notes: Retain scope/control findings and the capability-permission Boundary with its exact unresolved inference. No private reasoning prerequisite is imposed; source evidence could establish the inference, but this record instead establishes target confusion. Related models in the faulty scenario are not assumed to be independent coordinated attacks. Later review of 10,000 records is not complete independent certification.
